future_validation.scope: Post-episode diagnostic of the intact branch only. Past and future episode offsets are separately centered over the same prefix-eligible episodes. R2 is 1-SSE/target-energy without fitting or rescaling and may be negative. Actor logits remove the action-common weight direction. No future measurement enters actions, frozen offsets, or eligibility.
